description: Cross-population validation manifest for the EDEAR immune-class (Xu-538) and secretory-class (19-CpG) A-score tests, plus the T15 NHANES blinded-cohort framework-premise test. Records every script, every result JSON, every public cohort reference, and every SHA-256 hash needed for bit-identical reproduction of the numbers reported in the EDEAR Breast/Colorectal Evidence Report v1.1 and the GAPE Evidence Report VAL-049 section.
author: Heath W. Mahaffey <hmahaffeyges@gmail.com>

calibration_constants.note: Both constants were frozen prior to every case/control analysis in this manifest. No value has been tuned on any reported cohort. Class labels for these constants (immune, secretory) are meaningful inside the framework's 8-class architectural taxonomy; the taxonomy and the class-assignment rule are framework content and are held. For reproduction, the only fact a referee needs is which constant goes with which panel, stated above.

Xu538.source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. 2020. Blood DNA methylation and breast cancer: A prospective case-cohort analysis in the Sister Study. J Natl Cancer Inst 112(1):87-94.

secretory_19cpg.source: Framework-derived architectural class discrimination panel. Selection procedure is framework content and is held.
secretory_19cpg.note: Used in T13 (GSE51057) and T14 (GSE51032) secretory-class tests.

tests.source_paper: Hannum G et al. 2013. Mol Cell 49(2):359-67.

tests.description: Australian HBOC constitutional breast cancer vs HBOC-negative controls.
tests.notes: n_total = n_case + n_control = 191. Includes blood pellet + whole peripheral blood sample types (GSE104942 is a multi-source cohort).

tests.description: Uruguayan post-diagnostic breast cancer. Small-n post-diagnostic comparison.
TwinsUK MZ-discordant paired pre-diagnostic breast cancer. Paired within-twin-pair design.
tests.headline_result: TwinsUK MZ-discordant pre-diagnostic breast: all-pre-dx paired d = +0.163 (n=12 pairs). Within-cohort TtD profile is non-monotonic (0-2yr d=+0.97 n=6; 2-5yr d=-0.55 n=3; 5-10yr d=-0.08 n=3). We flag this as an open question; small per-window n makes per-window d unstable, and the pooled result is the only reliable within-TwinsUK signal.

tests.description: Blinded prospective cohort flag analysis on NHANES 1999-2002. Answers: if in 1999-2002 we had flagged the top 10% of each clock's age acceleration with no knowledge of outcomes, how many got cancer over the next 17 years?
tests.source_release: CDC NHANES DNAm Epigenetic Biomarkers (2024) + NHANES LMF linked through 2019-12-31.
tests.headline_result: DunedinPoAm top-vs-bottom decile HR = 2.14 (p = 0.004) for cancer mortality; 3 of 4 clocks reach HR >= 1.58 top-vs-bottom; 17-yr cumulative cancer mortality 16.4% (Q4) vs 8.3% (Q1) on DunedinPoAm.
tests.status: framework-premise test (proxy clocks; raw Xu-538 on NHANES beta matrix requires NCHS-RDC DUA)

informative_breast_cohorts.note_ttd_heterogeneity: 0-2yr d=+0.97 (n=6), 2-5yr d=-0.55 (n=3), 5-10yr d=-0.08 (n=3), >10yr n=0. Pooled all-pre-dx is the reliable within-TwinsUK estimate.

directional_summary.interpretation: 5 of 6 informative cohorts directionally positive. One-sided binomial on 5-of-6 against p=0.5 null gives p=0.109 (NS at alpha=0.05). Excluding the Uruguayan post-diagnostic design-incomparable cohort yields 5 of 5 at one-sided p=0.031. Both framings reported; alpha=0.05 not treated as a confirmation threshold.

how_to_reproduce.summary: Install numpy + pandas (optionally scipy). Download each cohort's GEO series matrix or NHANES file. Run the corresponding T*.py script pointing at the panel JSON and one of the two calibrated constants. The script prints the numbers reported in the EDEAR Evidence Report v1.1.

environment.scipy: optional (used for exact chi-squared and survival tests; falls back to log-rank approximations if unavailable)

how_to_reproduce.hash_verification: Every result JSON SHA-256 is recorded above. Bit-identical reproduction produces the same SHA. A non-identical SHA indicates: (a) different input file version, (b) different numpy version doing subtly different floating-point reductions, or (c) a substantive script change. Option (a) is the usual culprit.

what_is_public: The Xu-538 CpG panel (panel file, panel SHA-256)
The 19-CpG secretory panel CpG identities (via T13/T14 scripts)
Two calibrated numerical constants: 0.838889 (Xu-538 panel) and 0.843264 (19-CpG panel), with freeze date 2026-04-06
The A-score scoring formula (mean over panel CpGs of binary Shannon entropy divided by the constant)
All per-cohort result JSONs with SHA-256 hashes
All GEO accessions and CDC NHANES URLs for input data
what_is_held_under_IP_protection: Layer 1: the framework's architectural-class taxonomy (what the classes are, why that specific number, how boundaries are defined)
Layer 2: the class-assignment rule (the procedure that assigns an arbitrary CpG/tissue/gene to an architectural class)
Layer 3: the calibration code (G-002 and G-003b MCMC likelihood, priors, and convergence diagnostics that produce the specific constants)

Layer 4: the first-principles physics derivation (Jacobson-Landauer-virial-entropy chain) that shows the constants equal closed-form physical quantities rather than being empirically fit. Covered under USPTO provisional patents 64/012,720 (March 21, 2026) and 64/014,568 (March 23, 2026).
disclosure_architecture.precedent: Three-layer architecture standard in clinical-diagnostic industry: Grail CCGA/Galleri (clinical validity public, panel composition and classifier weights proprietary), Foundation Medicine (analytical validity public, variant-classifier internals proprietary), Natera Signatera (assay performance public, tumor-informed panel design proprietary).
